summary: Generic id-to-asset lookup for GameDataAsset subclasses. Subclass it concretely to create the asset.
overview: Turns a saved string id back into the asset it names. Unity does not allow [CreateAssetMenu] on a generic type, so make a concrete subclass to actually create one — ItemRegistry is exactly that.
useCases: Resolving ids from a save file back into assets.
Listing every item or enemy of a type for a debug menu or shop.
Keeping asset lookup in one place rather than Resources.Load calls.

params.tuning: An explicit list, not an automatic scan. Anything missing here is invisible to lookup, with no error.

gotchas.title: You cannot create the generic asset directly
gotchas.body: That is a Unity limitation, not an oversight. Subclass it concretely and put [CreateAssetMenu] on the subclass.
